title: Microstructure-Aware Volatility Surfaces and Cost-Efficient Delta-Hedging in Bitcoin Options
description: Reproducibility repository for the paper "Pricing with the Order Book: Microstructure-Aware Volatility Surfaces and Cost-Efficient Delta-Hedging in Bitcoin Options." A single pipeline downloads public Binance BTCUSDT option data, builds four pricing models and five delta-hedging policies, and regenerates every table and figure in the paper.
